verdict.rationale: cfo.ai's own docs say a CSV upload is a first-class way in, not a fallback. You can upload a CSV export from a system it does not connect to so the rows feed the Model. You can also connect a Google Sheet, or an Excel or CSV file in Google Drive, which Ari imports and keeps updated when the file changes. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and documentation of how uploaded files are mapped or validated and of direct (non-Drive) Excel upload.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can load a CSV or spreadsheet as a first-class data source when no connector exists

citations.quote: a CSV upload is a first-class way in, not a fallback.
Upload a CSV export, such as bank transactions or a report from a system cfo.ai does not connect to, so its rows feed your Model.
Connect a Google Sheet, or an Excel or CSV file in Google Drive, so Ari imports it into your Model and updates the Model when the file changes.
